card.name: Words just before "activity"
card.fires_on: Small linking words or verbs (the, for, show, display, has, no) right before the expected word "activity" or a similar biological-effect term, in pharmacology or biochemistry text.

modes.label: Potency comparison
modes.description: "the" after a multiplier, just before "activity" of a metabolite.
modes.example: which has 4- 7 times<< the>> activity of cilostazol, were

modes.label: Essential for function
modes.description: "for" after essential or important, before an enzyme activity or function.
modes.example: each of which is essential<< for>> triphosphatase activity. The

modes.label: Showing an effect
modes.description: Verbs or "no" before an effect or potential, such as mutagenic or inhibitory activity.
modes.example: Nabumetone did not<< show>> mutagenic potential in the Ames test

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict "activity" next and discourages "supply" words.
card.plain: It fires on a small word that sets up the word "activity", as in a drug's activity or an enzyme's activity.
